Street images: Hangzhou, Baidu street view (© Baidu). Task from Wang, Hu & Duolihong (2023), ISPRS International Journal of Geo-Information 12, 15, doi:10.3390/ijgi12010015.

config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views of Gongshu District, Hangzhou (front, back, left or right at each point, pitch 0°, 90° view), not the paper's stimuli. Participants compare two street views at a time and choose the one with better overall street spatial quality, as the ten urban-planning volunteers did in Wang, Hu & Duolihong (2023, ISPRS International Journal of Geo-Information). The paper turned the choices into quality scores with the ELO rating system (start score 1500) and used them to train a model for 45,508 views. Differences from the original study: (1) the paper compared views within the same road grade (arterial, secondary trunk, branch) and each volunteer made 500 comparisons; here pairs are drawn from all views and each participant makes 30; (2) field of study is recorded.

paper.title: Diagnosis and Planning Strategies for Quality of Urban Street Space Based on Street View Images
